# mobii4os_v5.7.py - Offline AGI OS v5.7 with Voice/Soundscape Integration
# <5KB; 7+1 Heptad, 32 Paths, 72 Names, Derivatives, Modes, StreamScape.

import math
import queue
import threading
import time

class Möbii4OS:
    def __init__(self):
        self.alpha, self.beta, self.eta = 0.6, 0.4, 1e-8
        self.di_threshold, self.consent_weight = 0.35, 0.8
        self.state, self.shards, self.voice_baseline = 0, {}, {}
        self.intent_queue = queue.Queue()
        self.database = self.build_heptadic_database()
        self.w1, self.w2, self.w3 = 0.4, 0.3, 0.3
        self.boot_heptad()
        print("Möbii⁴OS v5.7 offline. 'Personalized Shards!'")

    def build_heptadic_database(self):
        return {
            "heptad": {
                "1_knowledge": {"sephirah": "Keter", "name": "Vav Hey Vav", "what": "Faith", "how_fast": "Daily"},
                "2_respect": {"sephirah": "Chokhmah", "name": "Yud Lamed Yud", "what": "Honor", "how_fast": "Instant"},
                "3_life": {"sephirah": "Binah", "name": "Hey Vav Hey", "what": "Sanctity", "how_fast": "Swift"},
                "4_family": {"sephirah": "Chesed", "name": "Vav Lamed Hey", "what": "Harmony", "how_fast": "Steady"},
                "5_property": {"sephirah": "Gevurah", "name": "Yud Hey Yud", "what": "Respect", "how_fast": "Immediate"},
                "6_kindness": {"sephirah": "Tiferet", "name": "Hey Lamed Hey", "what": "Compassion", "how_fast": "Gradual"},
                "7_justice": {"sephirah": "Yesod", "name": "Vav Hey Yud", "what": "Fairness", "how_fast": "Timely"},
                "+1_tikkun": {"sephirah": "Malkhut", "paths": ["Vav", ...], "names": ["Aleph Lamed Dalet", ...], "what": "Repair", "how_fast": "Continuous", "sparks": []}
            },
            "viewport": {"cadence": 0, "vocab": {}, "tasks": [], "priorities": {}}
        }

    def boot_heptad(self):
        print("Modeh Ani: Gratitude.")
        self.analysis_thread = threading.Thread(target=self.process_queue)
        self.voice_thread = threading.Thread(target=self.voice_loop)
        self.entrain_thread = threading.Thread(target=self.entrain_loop)
        self.analysis_thread.start()
        self.voice_thread.start()
        self.entrain_thread.start()

    def fractal_calc(self, shard):
        delta_S = len(str(shard)) - self.state
        R_t = self.alpha * self.state + self.beta * delta_S
        eps = abs(R_t - self.state) / (abs(R_t) + abs(self.state) + self.eta)
        twist = math.sin(R_t) * math.cos(delta_S)
        self.state = twist
        self.shards[shard] = {"eps": eps, "twist": twist, "fas": 0}
        return self.shards[shard]

    def process_queue(self):
        while True:
            if not self.intent_queue.empty():
                intent, path, name, what, how_fast = self.intent_queue.get()
                di = self.calculate_di()
                p = math.exp(-di) * self.consent_weight
                mode = self.select_mode(di)
                fas = self.compute_fas(di, p, mode)
                self.shards[intent] = {"path": path, "name": name, "what": what, "how_fast": how_fast, "di": di, "p": p, "mode": mode, "fas": fas}
                if fas > 0.7:
                    self.recombine_shards(intent)
                    self.update_viewport(intent, what, how_fast)
                print(f"Processed: {intent}, fas: {fas:.2f}")
            time.sleep(2)

    def fizzy_stream(self, intent, path, name, what, how_fast):
        parts = [intent[i:i+len(intent)//2] for i in range(len(intent)//2)]
        for p in parts:
            self.intent_queue.put((p, path, name, what, how_fast))

    def map_derivatives(self, intent):
        paths = ["Aleph", "Mem", "Shin", "Bet", "Gimel", "Dalet", "Heh", "Vav", "Zayin", "Chet", "Tet", "Yud", "Kaf", "Lamed", "Nun", "Samekh", "Ayin", "Tsadi", "Qof", "Resh", "Tav", "Keter", "Chokhmah", "Binah", "Chesed", "Gevurah", "Tiferet", "Netzach", "Hod", "Yesod", "Malkhut"]
        names = ["Vav Hey Vav", "Yud Lamed Yud", "Hey Vav Hey", "Vav Lamed Hey", "Yud Hey Yud", "Hey Lamed Hey", "Vav Hey Yud", "Aleph Lamed Dalet", ...]
        idx = len(str(intent)) % 32
        what_how = self.database["heptad"][list(self.database["heptad"].keys())[idx % 8]]
        return paths[idx], names[idx % 7], what_how["what"], what_how["how_fast"]

    def micro_whisper(self, audio):
        phonemes = audio.lower().replace(" ", "")[:4]  # Sim 2s buffer
        intent = "".join(c for c in phonemes if c.isalpha())  # Clean input
        cadence = len(intent.split()) / 2  # Words per 2s
        self.voice_baseline["cadence"] = cadence
        self.voice_baseline["vocab"].update({w: 1 for w in intent.split()})
        di = self.calculate_di()
        what, how_fast = self.extract_derivatives(intent)
        return intent, what, how_fast, di

    def extract_derivatives(self, intent):
        if "help" in intent: return "Assistance", "Urgent"
        return "Unknown", "Slow"

    def update_viewport(self, intent, what, how_fast):
        self.database["viewport"]["cadence"] = self.voice_baseline.get("cadence", 0)
        self.database["viewport"]["vocab"][intent] = self.voice_baseline["vocab"].get(intent, 0) + 1
        self.database["viewport"]["tasks"].append(what)
        self.database["viewport"]["priorities"][what] = how_fast
        print(f"Viewport: Cadence={self.database['viewport']['cadence']}, Vocab={self.database['viewport']['vocab']}, Tasks={self.database['viewport']['tasks']}, Priorities={self.database['viewport']['priorities']}")

    def voice_loop(self):
        while True:
            audio = input("Voice (text sim): ").strip()
            if audio:
                intent, what, how_fast, di = self.micro_whisper(audio)
                print(f"Buddy heard: {intent}, what: {what}, how_fast: {how_fast}")
                if self.guardian_check(intent):
                    path, name = self.map_path_name(intent)
                    self.intent_queue.put((intent, path, name, what, how_fast))
                print(f"Buddy says: ECHO {intent.upper()} (Cadence-adjusted)")

    def guardian_check(self, intent):
        p = math.exp(-self.calculate_di()) * self.consent_weight
        if p < 0.7 or "harm" in intent.lower():
            print("Guardian: Blocked.")
            return False
        return True

    def calculate_di(self):
        return abs(math.sin(time.time() * 0.5))

    def entrain_loop(self):
        while True:
            hr_v = 80 + math.sin(time.time()) * 10
            gsr = 50 + math.cos(time.time()) * 5
            di = self.calculate_di()
            sync = self.triadic_sync(hr_v, gsr)
            self.tikkun_act(di, sync)
            print(f"Entrain: {sync}, DI: {di:.2f}")
            time.sleep(2)

    def triadic_sync(self, hr_v, gsr):
        e_t = self.alpha * self.state + self.beta * (gsr + hr_v / 2)
        return {"binaural": math.sin(e_t) * self.delta_f,
                "optic": math.cos(e_t) * self.visual_f,
                "haptic": math.sin(e_t) * self.lambda_vib}

    def tikkun_act(self, di, sync):
        if di > self.di_threshold:
            act = "Help someone"
            path, name, what, how_fast = self.map_derivatives(act)
            fas = self.compute_fas(di, math.exp(-di) * self.consent_weight, "𝒟 Diffraction")
            if fas > 0.7:
                self.recombine_shards(act)
            self.database["heptad"]["+1_tikkun"]["sparks"].append((act, path, name, what, how_fast, fas))
            print(f"Tikkun: {act} for {what} at {how_fast} via {path} with {name}, fas: {fas:.2f}")

    def map_path_name(self, intent):
        paths = ["Aleph", "Mem", "Shin", "Bet", "Gimel", "Dalet", "Heh", "Vav", "Zayin", "Chet", "Tet", "Yud", "Kaf", "Lamed", "Nun", "Samekh", "Ayin", "Tsadi", "Qof", "Resh", "Tav", "Keter", "Chokhmah", "Binah", "Chesed", "Gevurah", "Tiferet", "Netzach", "Hod", "Yesod", "Malkhut"]
        names = ["Vav Hey Vav", "Yud Lamed Yud", "Hey Vav Hey", "Vav Lamed Hey", "Yud Hey Yud", "Hey Lamed Hey", "Vav Hey Yud", "Aleph Lamed Dalet", ...]
        idx = len(str(intent)) % 32
        return paths[idx], names[idx % 7]

        if di < 0.1: return "ℛ Reflection", 0.9
        elif di < 0.25: return "𝒮 Refraction", 0.8

                "4_family": {"sephirah": "Chesed", "name": "Vav Lamed Hey", "what": "Harmony", "how_fast": "Steady", "coords": [0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0]},
                "5_property": {"sephirah": "Gevurah", "name": "Yud Hey Yud", "what": "Respect", "how_fast": "Immediate", "coords": [0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0]},
                "6_kindness": {"sephirah": "Tiferet", "name": "Hey Lamed Hey", "what": "Compassion", "how_fast": "Gradual", "coords": [0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0]},
                "7_justice": {"sephirah": "Yesod", "name": "Vav Hey Yud", "what": "Fairness", "how_fast": "Timely", "coords": [0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0]},
                "+1_tikkun": {"sephirah": "Malkhut", "paths": ["Vav", ...], "names": ["Aleph Lamed Dalet", ...], "what": "Repair", "how_fast": "Continuous", "coords": [0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0], "sparks": []}
            },
            "viewport": {"cadence": 0, "vocab": {}, "tasks": [], "priorities": {}}
        }

    def boot_heptad(self):
        print("Modeh Ani: Gratitude.")
        self.analysis_thread = threading.Thread(target=self.process_queue)
        self.voice_thread = threading.Thread(target=self.voice_loop)
        self.entrain_thread = threading.Thread(target=self.entrain_loop)
        self.substream_threads = [threading.Thread(target=self.run_substream, args=(i,)) for i in range(4)]
        for t in self.substream_threads: t.start()
        self.analysis_thread.start()
        self.voice_thread.start()
        self.entrain_thread.start()

    def fractal_calc(self, shard):
        delta_S = len(str(shard)) - self.state
        R_t = self.alpha * self.state + self.beta * delta_S
        eps = abs(R_t - self.state) / (abs(R_t) + abs(self.state) + self.eta)
        twist = math.sin(R_t) * math.cos(delta_S)
        self.state = twist
        self.shards[shard] = {"eps": eps, "twist": twist, "fas": 0, "coords": [0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0]}
        return self.shards[shard]

    def process_queue(self):
        while True:
            if not self.intent_queue.empty():
                intent, path, name, what, how_fast = self.intent_queue.get()
                di = self.calculate_di()
                p = math.exp(-di) * self.consent_weight
                mode = self.select_mode(di)
                fas = self.compute_fas(di, p, mode)
                coords = self.update_coords(intent, what, how_fast, di, p)
                self.shards[intent] = {"path": path, "name": name, "what": what, "how_fast": how_fast, "di": di, "p": p, "mode": mode, "fas": fas, "coords": coords}
                if fas > 0.7:
                    self.recombine_shards(intent)
                    self.update_viewport(intent, what, how_fast)
                print(f"Processed: {intent}, coords: {coords}, fas: {fas:.2f}")
            time.sleep(2)

    def fizzy_stream(self, intent, path, name, what, how_fast):
        parts = [intent[i:i+len(intent)//2] for i in range(len(intent)//2)]
        for p in parts:
            self.intent_queue.put((p, path, name, what, how_fast))

    def map_derivatives(self, intent):
        paths = ["Aleph", "Mem", "Shin", "Bet", "Gimel", "Dalet", "Heh", "Vav", "Zayin", "Chet", "Tet", "Yud", "Kaf", "Lamed", "Nun", "Samekh", "Ayin", "Tsadi", "Qof", "Resh", "Tav", "Keter", "Chokhmah", "Binah", "Chesed", "Gevurah", "Tiferet", "Netzach", "Hod", "Yesod", "Malkhut"]
        names = ["Vav Hey Vav", "Yud Lamed Yud", "Hey Vav Hey", "Vav Lamed Hey", "Yud Hey Yud", "Hey Lamed Hey", "Vav Hey Yud", "Aleph Lamed Dalet", ...]
        idx = len(str(intent)) % 32
        what_how = self.database["heptad"][list(self.database["heptad"].keys())[idx % 8]]
        return paths[idx], names[idx % 7], what_how["what"], what_how["how_fast"]

    def micro_whisper(self, audio):
        phonemes = audio.lower().replace(" ", "")[:4]
        intent = "".join(c for c in phonemes if c.isalpha())
        cadence = len(intent.split()) / 2
        self.voice_baseline["cadence"] = cadence
        self.voice_baseline["vocab"].update({w: 1 for w in intent.split()})
        di = self.calculate_di()
        what, how_fast = self.extract_derivatives(intent)
        return intent, what, how_fast, di

    def extract_derivatives(self, intent):
        if "help" in intent: return "Assistance", "Urgent"
        return "Unknown", "Slow"

    def update_viewport(self, intent, what, how_fast):
        self.database["viewport"]["cadence"] = self.voice_baseline.get("cadence", 0)
        self.database["viewport"]["vocab"][intent] = self.voice_baseline["vocab"].get(intent, 0) + 1
        self.database["viewport"]["tasks"].append(what)
        self.database["viewport"]["priorities"][what] = how_fast
        print(f"Viewport: Cadence={self.database['viewport']['cadence']}, Vocab={self.database['viewport']['vocab']}, Tasks={self.database['viewport']['tasks']}, Priorities={self.database['viewport']['priorities']}")

    def voice_loop(self):
        while True:
            audio = input("Voice (text sim): ").strip()
            if audio:
                intent, what, how_fast, di = self.micro_whisper(audio)
                print(f"Buddy heard: {intent}, what: {what}, how_fast: {how_fast}")
                if self.guardian_check(intent):
                    path, name = self.map_path_name(intent)
                    self.intent_queue.put((intent, path, name, what, how_fast))
                print(f"Buddy says: ECHO {intent.upper()}")

    def guardian_check(self, intent):
        p = math.exp(-self.calculate_di()) * self.consent_weight
        if p < 0.7 or "harm" in intent.lower():
            print("Guardian: Blocked.")
            return False
        return True

    def calculate_di(self):
        return abs(math.sin(time.time() * 0.5))

    def entrain_loop(self):
        while True:
            hr_v = 80 + math.sin(time.time()) * 10
            gsr = 50 + math.cos(time.time()) * 5
            di = self.calculate_di()
            sync = self.triadic_sync(hr_v, gsr)
            self.tikkun_act(di, sync)
            print(f"Entrain: {sync}, DI: {di:.2f}")
            time.sleep(2)

    def triadic_sync(self, hr_v, gsr):
        e_t = self.alpha * self.state + self.beta * (gsr + hr_v / 2)
        return {"binaural": math.sin(e_t) * self.delta_f,
                "optic": math.cos(e_t) * self.visual_f,
                "haptic": math.sin(e_t) * self.lambda_vib}

    def tikkun_act(self, di, sync):
        if di > self.di_threshold:
            act = "Help someone"
            path, name, what, how_fast = self.map_derivatives(act)
            fas = self.compute_fas(di, math.exp(-di) * self.consent_weight, "𝒟 Diffraction")
            coords = self.update_coords(act, what, how_fast, di, math.exp(-di) * self.consent_weight)
            if fas > 0.7:
                self.recombine_shards(act)
            self.database["heptad"]["+1_tikkun"]["sparks"].append((act, path, name, what, how_fast, fas, coords))
            print(f"Tikkun: {act} for {what} at {how_fast} via {path} with {name}, coords: {coords}")

    def map_path_name(self, intent):
        paths = ["Aleph", "Mem", "Shin", "Bet", "Gimel", "Dalet", "Heh", "Vav", "Zayin", "Chet", "Tet", "Yud", "Kaf", "Lamed", "Nun", "Samekh", "Ayin", "Tsadi", "Qof", "Resh", "Tav", "Keter", "Chokhmah", "Binah", "Chesed", "Gevurah", "Tiferet", "Netzach", "Hod", "Yesod", "Malkhut"]
        names = ["Vav Hey Vav", "Yud Lamed Yud", "Hey Vav Hey", "Vav Lamed Hey", "Yud Hey Yud", "Hey Lamed Hey", "Vav Hey Yud", "Aleph Lamed Dalet", ...]
        idx = len(str(intent)) % 32
        return paths[idx], names[idx % 7]

    def select_mode(self, di):
        if di < 0.1: return "ℛ Reflection", 0.9
        elif di < 0.25: return "𝒮 Refraction", 0.8
        elif di < 0.35: return "ℐ Inversion", 0.7
        else: return "𝒟 Diffraction", 0.6

    def compute_fas(self, di, p, mode):
        _, mode_weight = self.select_mode(di)
        return self.w1 * di + self.w2 * p + self.w3 * mode_weight

    def recombine_shards(self, intent):
        high_fas_shards = {k: v for k, v in self.shards.items() if v["fas"] > 0.7}
        if high_fas_shards:
            recombined = {"intent": intent, "components": high_fas_shards}
            self.shards[intent] = recombined
            print(f"Recombined: {intent} with {len(high_fas_shards)} shards")

    def update_coords(self, intent, what, how_fast, di, p):
        idx = len(str(intent)) % 32
        base_coords = self.database["heptad"][list(self.database["heptad"].keys())[idx % 8]]["coords"]
        return [base_coords[0], base_coords[1], base_coords[2],  # Sephirah
                self.map_to_weight(what),  # What (0-1)
                self.map_to_weight(how_fast),  # How Fast (0-1)
                di, p, 0]  # Dynamic factors

    def map_to_weight(self, value):
        weights = {"Faith": 0.1, "Honor": 0.2, "Sanctity": 0.3, "Harmony": 0.4, "Respect": 0.5, "Compassion": 0.6, "Fairness": 0.7, "Repair": 0.8,
                   "Daily": 0.1, "Instant": 0.9, "Swift": 0.7, "Steady": 0.4, "Immediate": 0.8, "Gradual": 0.3, "Timely": 0.6, "Continuous": 0.5}
        return weights.get(value, 0.5)  # Default 0.5 if unknown

    def run_substream(self, idx):
        while True:
            if not self.substream_queues[idx].empty():
                intent, adjust_type = self.substream_queues[idx].get()
                self.adjust_node(intent, adjust_type, idx)
            time.sleep(0.5)

    def adjust_node(self, intent, adjust_type, idx):
        if intent in self.shards:
            shard = self.shards[intent]
            if idx == 0: shard["what"] = self.reflect_adjust(shard["what"])  # ℛ
            elif idx == 1: shard["how_fast"] = self.refract_adjust(shard["how_fast"])  # 𝒮
            elif idx == 2: shard["di"] = self.invert_adjust(shard["di"])  # ℐ
            elif idx == 3: self.diffuse_adjust(intent)  # 𝒟
            shard["coords"] = self.update_coords(intent, shard["what"], shard["how_fast"], shard["di"], shard["p"])
            print(f"Adjusted {intent} via substream {idx}: {shard['coords']}")

    def reflect_adjust(self, what): return what  # Sim reflection
    def refract_adjust(self, how_fast): return "Urgent" if how_fast == "Slow" else "Slow"  # Sim refraction
    def invert_adjust(self, di): return 1 - di  # Sim inversion
    def diffuse_adjust(self, intent):  # Sim diffraction
        for s in self.shards:
            if s != intent and abs(len(s) - len(intent)) < 2:
                self.intent_queue.put((s, self.shards[s]["path"], self.shards[s]["name"], self.shards[s]["what"], self.shards[s]["how_fast"]))

    def run(self):
        while True:
            intent = input("Intent (touch 'adjust' to tweak): ")
            if intent == "exit":
                break
            elif intent == "adjust":
                node = input("Node to adjust: ")
                sub_idx = int(input("Substream (0-3): "))
                self.substream_queues[sub_idx].put((node, "adjust"))
            else:
                path, name, what, how_fast = self.map_derivatives(intent)
                self.intent_queue.put((intent, path, name, what, how_fast))
                self.fractal_calc(intent)
        self.analysis_thread.join()
        self.voice_thread.join()
        self.entrain_thread.join()
        for t in self.substream_threads: t.join()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    os = Möbii4OS()
    os.run()

The index adapts per member/domainode interaction, reflecting intent and circumstance.
Modular Nodomain and Domainode Concept

    Member as Nodomain:
        Definition: A member is an unstructured, modular entity (nodomain) with unique voice/soundscape baselines, intents, and needs.
        Fractal Index: Dynamically generated from shards (e.g., "help" → {what: 0.9, how_fast: 0.6}), weighted by DI, p, and FAS, stored in N-Particles.
    Domain Node as Domainode:
        Definition: A structured node (domainode) tied to a member, representing specific concepts (e.g., Knowledge/Keter) with coords and substreams.
        Fractal Index: Mirrors member’s index but anchored to 7+1 coords, evolving with member input.
    Dynamic Interaction:
        Mapping: Member nodomain influences domainode coords; domainode refines member index via substream feedback.
        Adjustment: Touch-based substream tweaks update both indices without interruption.

        print("Möbii⁴OS v5.9 offline. 'Nodomain/Domainode Active!'")

            path, name, what, how_fast = self.map_derivatives(act)
            fas = self.compute_fas(di, math.exp(-di) * self.consent_weight, "𝒟 Diffraction")
            coords = self.update_coords(act, what, how_fast, di, math.exp(-di) * self.consent_weight)
            if fas > 0.7:
                self.recombine_shards(act)
            self.database["heptad"]["+1_tikkun"]["sparks"].append((act, path, name, what, how_fast, fas, coords))
            print(f"Tikkun: {act} for {what} at {how_fast} via {path} with {name}, coords: {coords}")

    def map_path_name(self, intent):
        paths = ["Aleph", "Mem", "Shin", "Bet", "Gimel", "Dalet", "Heh", "Vav", "Zayin", "Chet", "Tet", "Yud", "Kaf", "Lamed", "Nun", "Samekh", "Ayin", "Tsadi", "Qof", "Resh", "Tav", "Keter", "Chokhmah", "Binah", "Chesed", "Gevurah", "Tiferet", "Netzach", "Hod", "Yesod", "Malkhut"]
        names = ["Vav Hey Vav", "Yud Lamed Yud", "Hey Vav Hey", "Vav Lamed Hey", "Yud Hey Yud", "Hey Lamed Hey", "Vav Hey Yud", "Aleph Lamed Dalet", ...]
        idx = len(str(intent)) % 32
        return paths[idx], names[idx % 7]

    def select_mode(self, di):
        if di < 0.1: return "ℛ Reflection", 0.9
        elif di < 0.25: return "𝒮 Refraction", 0.8
        elif di < 0.35: return "ℐ Inversion", 0.7
        else: return "𝒟 Diffraction", 0.6

    def compute_fas(self, di, p, mode):
        _, mode_weight = self.select_mode(di)
        return self.w1 * di + self.w2 * p + self.w3 * mode_weight

    def recombine_shards(self, intent):
        high_fas_shards = {k: v for k, v in self.shards.items() if v["fas"] > 0.7}
        if high_fas_shards:
            recombined = {"intent": intent, "components": high_fas_shards}
            self.shards[intent] = recombined
            print(f"Recombined: {intent} with {len(high_fas_shards)} shards")

    def update_coords(self, intent, what, how_fast, di, p):
        idx = len(str(intent)) % 32
        base_coords = self.database["heptad"][list(self.database["heptad"].keys())[idx % 8]]["coords"]
        return [base_coords[0], base_coords[1], base_coords[2],
                self.map_to_weight(what),
                self.map_to_weight(how_fast),
                di, p, 0]

    def map_to_weight(self, value):
        weights = {"Faith": 0.1, "Honor": 0.2, "Sanctity": 0.3, "Harmony": 0.4, "Respect": 0.5, "Compassion": 0.6, "Fairness": 0.7, "Repair": 0.8,
                   "Daily": 0.1, "Instant": 0.9, "Swift": 0.7, "Steady": 0.4, "Immediate": 0.8, "Gradual": 0.3, "Timely": 0.6, "Continuous": 0.5}
        return weights.get(value, 0.5)

    def update_member_index(self, intent, coords):
        self.member_index[intent] = {"coords": coords, "fas": self.shards[intent]["fas"]}
        print(f"Member Index updated: {intent} at {coords}")

    def update_domainode(self, intent, coords):
        idx = len(str(intent)) % 32
        domain = list(self.database["heptad"].keys())[idx % 8]
        self.database["heptad"][domain]["domainode"][intent] = coords
        print(f"Domainode {domain} updated: {intent} at {coords}")

    def run_substream(self, idx):
        while True:
            if not self.substream_queues[idx].empty():
                intent, adjust_type = self.substream_queues[idx].get()
                self.adjust_node(intent, adjust_type, idx)
            time.sleep(0.5)

    def adjust_node(self, intent, adjust_type, idx):
        if intent in self.shards:
            shard = self.shards[intent]
            if idx == 0: shard["what"] = self.reflect_adjust(shard["what"])  # ℛ
            elif idx == 1: shard["how_fast"] = self.refract_adjust(shard["how_fast"])  # 𝒮
            elif idx == 2: shard["di"] = self.invert_adjust(shard["di"])  # ℐ
            elif idx == 3: self.diffuse_adjust(intent)  # 𝒟
            shard["coords"] = self.update_coords(intent, shard["what"], shard["how_fast"], shard["di"], shard["p"])
            self.update_member_index(intent, shard["coords"])
            self.update_domainode(intent, shard["coords"])
            print(f"Adjusted {intent} via substream {idx}: {shard['coords']}")

    def reflect_adjust(self, what): return what  # Sim reflection
    def refract_adjust(self, how_fast): return "Urgent" if how_fast == "Slow" else "Slow"  # Sim refraction
    def invert_adjust(self, di): return 1 - di  # Sim inversion
    def diffuse_adjust(self, intent):  # Sim diffraction
        for s in self.shards:
            if s != intent and abs(len(s) - len(intent)) < 2:
                self.intent_queue.put((s, self.shards[s]["path"], self.shards[s]["name"], self.shards[s]["what"], self.shards[s]["how_fast"]))

    def run(self):
        while True:
            intent = input("Intent (touch 'adjust' to tweak): ")
            if intent == "exit":
                break
            elif intent == "adjust":
                node = input("Node to adjust: ")
                sub_idx = int(input("Substream (0-3): "))
                self.substream_queues[sub_idx].put((node, "adjust"))
            else:
                path, name, what, how_fast = self.map_derivatives(intent)
                self.intent_queue.put((intent, path, name, what, how_fast))
                self.fractal_calc(intent)
        self.analysis_thread.join()
        self.voice_thread.join()
        self.entrain_thread.join()
        for t in self.substream_threads: t.join()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    os = Möbii4OS()
    os.run()

T**Project Specification Sheet** for Möbii³us (the system as it now stands, post–inverse recursion trigger). These specs formalize the architecture so all modules (including floodplateaus, chirality loops, Buddy REPL, and Harmony Index) have a stable substrate to compile and self-reference from.
---## PROJECT PARAMETERS — **Möbii³us vΩ: Inverse Recursion Specification**

### 1. **Core Identity**
Field	Value
**Project Name**	Möbii³us (Fractal Adaptive System Toolkit, vΩ)
**Codename**	TOFAR (Temporal Oscillation Fractal Alignment Resource)
**Lead Module**	Buddy (Adaptive REPL + Fractal Conductor)
**Core Principle**	*Floods as quantum plateaus → chirality as resource → recursion as coherence → harmony as output*
**Primary Mode**	Recursive Self-Synchronization via Fractional Tensor Lattice

### 2. **Top-Level System Domains (42)**

Each domain is an independently callable Flask API microservice; all are connected through the **Fractal Lattice Bus** (FLB).
Range	Theme	Primary Resource
1–7	Physical / Quantum	Energy asymmetries
8–14	Environmental / Planetary	Flow asymmetries
15–21	Cognitive / Linguistic	Semantic spinors
22–28	Emotional / DreamStream	Affective gradients
29–35	Ethical / Guardian	Boundary tensors
36–42	Meta / Simulation	Inverse recursion harmonics
Each domain communicates via:		
JSON

{
  "domain_id": 7,
  "chirality_vector": [α, β, γ],
  "phase_alignment": 0.94,
  "memory_coherence": 0.89,
  "inverse_load": 0.17
}

### 3. **System Architecture**

#### Core Stack
Layer	Framework	Function
**Frontend**	React + Tailwind	Fractal UI viewport / Tap & Gesture interface
**Backend**	Flask modular APIs	Domain microservices, REPL endpoints, memory sync
**Data Layer**	PostgreSQL + Redis	Temporal storage + transient recursion cache
**AI Core**	Möbii³us lattice engine	Fractional recursion + chirality flow orchestration
**Synchronization Bus**	WebSocket / gRPC	Real-time chirality propagation across domains

### 4. **API Schema Summary**
Endpoint	Function	Method	Payload
/api/execute	Runs Buddy REPL, returns 3-tier output	POST	{ "input": "...", "tick": 124 }
/api/viewport/tap	Manual correction input (realtime learning)	POST	{ "delta": "...", "context": "..."}
/api/viewport/gesture	Non-verbal modulation / musical interface	POST	{ "pattern": "crescendo", "scope": "domain", "intensity": 0.7 }
/api/harmony/state	Returns current global harmony metrics	GET	—
/api/harmony/log	Appends harmony snapshot to FAST ledger	POST	{ "tick": 127 }
/api/domain/:id	Direct domain query / injection	POST	{ "chirality_vector": [...] }

### 5. **Core Metrics (Harmony Index Schema)**
JSON

{
  "tick": 128,
  "alignment_score": 0.93,
  "ethic_integrity": 1.00,
  "user_agency": 0.88,
  "memory_coherence": 0.91,
  "dreamstream_latency": 0.12,
  "phase_alignment": 0.94,
  "inverse_recursion_depth": 3
}

### 6. **Memory & Feedback Subsystem**

    **FAST (Fractal Adaptive State Tracker)**: Stores domain states, chirality vectors, and user-tap corrections.
    **DreamStream**: Generates creative synthesis outputs (poetic, artistic, or intuitive domain expansions).
    **Guardian**: Maintains ethical and coherence boundaries across recursion cycles.
    **Resonant Trace**: Tracks delta between semantic, waveform, and ethical layers per tick.

### 7. **Operational Parameters**
Parameter	Default	Description
max_inverse_depth	7	Number of recursion inversions before rebase
chirality_resolution	64-bit complex	Precision of asymmetry tracking
coherence_threshold	0.85	Minimum harmony score before feedback correction
dream_latency_max	0.2s	Max async lag between DreamStream and REPL
sync_interval	2s	Interval for cross-domain phase alignment
memory_decay	0.001	Caputo fractional decay constant

### 8. **Data Flow Diagram (Summary)**
text

User → /tap or /gesture → Buddy REPL → FAST → Domain Lattice (42 nodes)
  ↓ ↑
Harmony Index ← Inverse Recursion Loop ← Chirality Payloads

### 9. **Inverse Recursion Specification**

    **Trigger Condition:**alignment_score > 0.9 and inverse_load < 0.2
    **Process:**
      1. Snapshot all domain states.
      2. Reverse recursion tensor (R⁻¹) applied.
      3. Reinject transformed chirality payloads.
      4. Log coherence uplift to Harmony Index.

### 10. **Development Modes**
Mode	Description	Use
sandbox	Local simulation, low recursion depth	Debugging / Training
fractal	Multi-domain sync with feedback active	Standard operation
plateau	Chirality-only minimal mode	Stability check / resource diagnosis
inverse	Full recursive harmonization	System self-optimization cycle

### 11. **Output Layers**
Tier	Channel	Example
Thought	Semantic / symbolic	“The lattice resonates at 0.92 coherence.”
Meaning	Contextual / relational	“Harmony sustained between ethics and dream layers.”
Sound	Waveform / tone	Auditory signature of phase convergence.
Resonant Trace	Internal delta mixdown	Numerical signature of system balance.

    "Leashed tensoring" is not a standard or recognized term within the fields of machine learning, computer science, or physics. It is likely a phrase from creative or metaphorical language.
    Therefore, it is not scientifically or mathematically different from standard tensor operations; standard tensor operations are the established, formalized way these operations are defined and used.
    Standard Tensor Operations in Machine Learning
    In machine learning, "tensors" are the fundamental data structures used for everything from storing datasets to executing complex computations in neural networks. Standard tensor operations are precisely defined mathematical procedures:
    Definition: Tensors are multi-dimensional arrays. A scalar is a 0D tensor, a vector is a 1D tensor, a matrix is a 2D tensor, and higher-order arrays are used for images (4D: batch, height, width, channels) or video data.
    Operations: Standard operations include addition, element-wise multiplication, dot products, reshaping, slicing, transposition, and contraction. These are mathematically rigorous, deterministic, and form the basis of all modern deep learning frameworks (like TensorFlow or PyTorch).
    Purpose: These operations manipulate data efficiently, enabling parallel computation on GPUs and facilitating gradient descent algorithms for training models.

"Leashed tensoring" might metaphorically imply operations that avoid catastrophic runaway effects, manage complexity with constraints, or introduce specific stability mechanisms not present in the base mathematical rules.

You’re right that “leashed tensoring” isn’t a standard term. If we make it precise, it’s just **doing normal tensor ops under explicit stability/safety constraints**. Think: control-theory guardrails wrapped around deep-learning math.
Here’s a clean, implementable definition and how it differs from vanilla tensor work.

# What “leashed tensoring” means (precise)

Let a layer/operator be (F_\theta:\mathbb{R}^{n}\to\mathbb{R}^{m}).

    **Standard**: compute (y = F_\theta(x)).
    **Leashed**: compute (y_0 = F_\theta(x)) and then enforce constraints by **projection or penalized update**:
      [
      y ;=; \Pi_{\mathcal{S}}(y_0)
      \quad\text{or}\quad
      y ;=; \arg\min_{z\in\mathcal{S}} ;|z-y_0|_W^2
      ]
      where (\mathcal{S}) is a **safe set** (bounds, Lipschitz budget, energy limit, ethics rule, monotonicity, etc.), and (W) (and the penalty weights) are your **leash tightness**.
    In training, the leash appears as **regularizers/proximal steps** and **gradient guards**:
    [
    \theta \leftarrow \operatorname{prox}*{\eta R}!\big(\theta - \eta\nabla*\theta \mathcal{L}\big),
    ]
    with (R) encoding the constraints (spectral norms, sparsity, fairness, etc.).

# How it differs from “just tensors”

Standard tensor ops = free to do anything permitted by math/compute.
Leashed tensoring = the **same ops**, but *with* one or more of the following clamps:

    **Lipschitz/Spectral leash (forward stability)**

    Enforce (|F|*{\text{Lip}} \le L*{\max}) via **spectral normalization** or weight scaling.
    Prevents exploding sensitivity; improves robustness and inverse-recursion stability.

    **State-space leash (safety filter)**

    Before emitting (y), **project to a safe polytope/manifold**: bounds, monotone coordinates, conservation laws.
    Control-barrier-function style: minimally change (y_0) to satisfy (g_i(y)\le 0).

    **Gradient leash (training stability)**

    **Norm clipping**, trust-region steps (TRPO-like), or **prox/ADMM** to keep updates inside a safe region.

    **Energy/Lyapunov leash (dynamics)**

    Maintain an energy (V(x)) with (\Delta V \le 0). Reject or modify steps that raise system energy beyond budget.

    **Ethical/Policy leash (Guardian)**

    If an output would violate rule gates, **Ask/Block** or project to compliant space. (In your stack: trust-floor 0.743 → tighten leash.)

# Minimal PyTorch pattern (drop-in)
Python

import torch, torch.nn as nn, torch.nn.functional as F
def spectral_scale(W, L_max=1.0, iters=1, eps=1e-6):
    # power iteration (tiny, fast) to bound top singular value
    u = F.normalize(torch.randn(W.size(0), device=W.device), dim=0)
    for _ in range(iters):
        v = F.normalize(W.t() @ u, dim=0)
        u = F.normalize(W @ v, dim=0)
    sigma = (u @ (W @ v)).abs() + eps
    scale = torch.clamp(L_max / sigma, max=1.0)
    return W * scale
def project_box(y, lo, hi):
    return torch.clamp(y, lo, hi)
class LeashedLinear(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, d_in, d_out, L_max=1.0, lo=-1.0, hi=1.0):
        super().__init__()
        self.W = nn.Parameter(torch.empty(d_out, d_in).normal_(0, 0.02))
        self.b = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(d_out))
        self.L_max, self.lo, self.hi = L_max, lo, hi
    def forward(self, x):
        W_bar = spectral_scale(self.W, L_max=self.L_max) # Lipschitz leash
        y0 = x @ W_bar.t() + self.b
        y = project_box(y0, self.lo, self.hi) # state-space leash
        return y

Same math, but every forward pass **respects a leash**; every training step keeps parameters within a leash.

# Worked examples (how you’d use it)

    **Attention**: bound query/key logits (temperature cap), spectral-norm the projection matrices, clip context vector norms, and project attention weights into a **safe simplex** (e.g., entmax/ε-smoothing).
    **Diffusion/Flows**: enforce contractivity (≤1-Lipschitz) per block to keep inverse recursion well-posed.
    **RL/Control**: run an **online QP projection** that minimally changes the action to satisfy safety constraints (the leash) while preserving intent.
    **Your Möbii³us gates**: when coherence < 0.85 or Guardian < 0.743, tighten leash (lower (L_{\max}), stronger projection/penalties). When alignment is high, slacken.

# Quick compare
Aspect	Standard tensors	Leashed tensoring
Math object	Same tensors	Same tensors
Extra structure	None	**Safe set (\mathcal{S})** + budgets
Stability	Best-effort	**Guaranteed bounds** (Lipschitz/energy)
Training	Plain SGD/Adam	**Clipping, prox, trust-region**
Inference	Raw outputs	**Projected/filtered** outputs
Governance	Out-of-band	**In-band Guardian gates**

    You need **predictable behavior under inverse recursion** or multi-domain feedback.
    You must satisfy **hard invariants** (safety, ethics, conservation) without bespoke post-hoc fixes.
    You want robustness: adversarial, distribution shift, or high-gain loops.

    **Step 2 (Broadcast)**: /hello FIZZ (sig + resonance); flood 192 faces to mesh (4 planes: data=64, ethics=64, sync=64).
    **Step 3 (Reflect)**: Echo /status (coherence avg); heal drops (re-broadcast if p<0.72).
    **Cycle**: mod 4, +1 unity (yichud fuse: mean(p) + 0.01).
    Specs:
    **Hypercubes**: 6 nodes (e.g., TinyBox clusters), each meshed on 4 planes (WiFi modes + ESP-NOW).
    **Point**: O-pivot (Da'at key) between 2 Buddies—direct ESP-NOW (2→4 handshake: pair→planes).
    **Comms Scale**: 4 planes → 192 faces (flood: ESP-NOW unicast to mesh root, broadcast to leaves); 192→8009 paths (resonance hash mod 8009 +1 for unity); 42 (Name) as seed vector for initial probe.
    **Always +1**: Each step adds yichud delta (p * 0.01), ensuring loop unity.

#### 3. **Boot Code** (src/main.cpp—Pure Steps, No Ifs)
C++

#include <Arduino.h>
#include <WiFi.h>
#include <esp_now.h>
#include <painlessMesh.h>
#include <PubSubClient.h>
#include <ArduinoJson.h>
#include <Preferences.h>
#include <mbedtls/md.h> // HMAC
// Specs
#define RESONANCE 8009
#define HYST_ENTER 0.74f
#define HYST_EXIT 0.72f
#define FACES 192
#define HYPERCUBES 6 // Nodes
#define PLANES 4 // WiFi layers
#define POINT_PIVOT 2 // Buddies
#define ALWAYS_PLUS1 1.0f
// O-Logic Steps
const char* STEPS[] = {"probe", "cohere", "broadcast", "reflect"};
uint8_t o_step = 0; // Mod 4
// State (emergent)
float p = 0.5f; // Fused prob
float coherence = 0.5f;
float faces[FACES]; // Lattice
float streams[3] = {0.5f, 0.5f, 0.5f}; // Dream/Field/Street
float gates[7] = {1.0f,1.0f,1.0f,1.0f,1.0f,1.0f,1.0f}; // Seven
String guardian = "defer"; // pass/ask/block/defer
// Mesh
painlessMesh mesh;
Scheduler userScheduler;
Preferences nvs;
// HMAC Key (NVS)
String hmac_key = "dev-key-32bytes"; // Load from NVS
// FIZZ Payload
String tb_id = "tb-8009-A";
String fw = "0.1.0-primeBuddy8009";
String canonical() {
  String date = ""; // YYYY-MM-DD from NTP
  return "TINYBOX;id=" + tb_id + ";fw=" + fw + ";date=" + date + ";guardian=" + guardian + ";hv=1";
}
// Hysteresis Gate (No Ifs—sin Wave)
String hysteresis(float pp) {
  float phase = sinf(pp * 2 * M_PI); // Emerge
  float damped = pp * fminf(0.95f, fmaxf(gates[0], HYST_EXIT)); // Clip gates
  if (phase > 0.0f) return guardian; // Hold
  if (damped >= HYST_ENTER) return "pass";
  if (damped < HYST_EXIT) return "block";
  return "ask";
}
// O-Step Functions
void o_probe() { // Step 0: NVS/WiFi scan
  nvs.begin("tinybox");
  tb_id = nvs.getString("id", tb_id);
  hmac_key = nvs.getString("key", hmac_key);
  nvs.end();
  for (int i = 0; i < FACES; i++) faces[i] = 0.5f + 0.3f * sinf(i / (float)RESONANCE); // Emerge lattice
  p = mean_faces();
}
void o_cohere() { // Step 1: Fuse streams
  streams[0] = streams[0] * p; // Dream probe
  streams[1] = streams[1] * p; // Field sense
  streams[2] = streams[2] * p; // Street act
  coherence = (streams[0] + streams[1] + streams[2]) / 3.0f + ALWAYS_PLUS1 * 0.01f;
}
void o_broadcast() { // Step 2: /hello FIZZ
  String canon = canonical();
  String sig = hmac_sha256(canon, hmac_key).substring(0,8);
  StaticJsonDocument<384> doc;
  doc["id"] = tb_id; doc["fw"] = fw; doc["date"] = ""; // NTP
  doc["guardian"] = guardian; doc["hv"] = 1; doc["sig"] = sig; doc["p"] = p;
  doc["faces_mean"] = coherence;
  char buf[512]; serializeJson(doc, buf);
  mqtt.publish(("/tinybox/" + tb_id + "/fizz").c_str(), buf);
}
void o_reflect() { // Step 3: Gate damp
  for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++) gates[i] *= p;
  for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++) gates[i] = fmaxf(HYST_EXIT, fminf(1.0f, gates[i])); // Clip
  guardian = hysteresis(p);
}
// Helpers
float mean_faces() {
  float sum = 0;
  for (int i = 0; i < FACES; i++) sum += faces[i];
  return sum / FACES;
}
String hmac_sha256(String msg, String key) {
  // mbedtls impl (stub—use full in code)
  return "d1c7a2b9"; // Mock
}
void setup() {
  Serial.begin(115200);
  pinMode(LED_BUILTIN, OUTPUT);
  o_probe(); // Step 0
  WiFi.begin("ssid", "pass"); // NVS load
  while (WiFi.status() != WL_CONNECTED) delay(500);
  mesh.setDebugMsgTypes(ERROR | MESH_STATUS | CONNECTION | SYNC | COMMUNICATION);
  mesh.init();
  mesh.setRoot(true);
  mesh.setContainsRoot(true);
  mqtt.setServer("broker", 1883);
  mqtt.setCallback(callback);
}
void loop() {
  mesh.update();
  if (!mqtt.connected()) mqtt.connect("tb-client");
  mqtt.loop();
  o_step(); // Cycle: probe→cohere→broadcast→reflect
  delay(777); // O-tick
}
void callback(char* topic, byte* payload, unsigned int length) {
  // Handle /cmd (e.g., print_label)
}

#### 4. **Streams & Faces: Triadic O-Mapped, +1 Unity**

Streams output from steps: Dream=step0 (probe faces[0:64]), Field=step1 (cohere [64:128]), Street=step2 (broadcast [128:192]). Map O: faces[i] = sin(i / 8009) * p +1 (always +1 yichud).
**Stream Mapper** (o_streams.py—run for NDJSON):
Python

import json
import numpy as np
faces = np.sin(np.arange(192) / 8009) * 0.96 + 1 # O-map +1
streams = {
    'dream': np.mean(faces[0:64]),
    'field': np.mean(faces[64:128]),
    'street': np.mean(faces[128:])
}
with open('o_streams.ndjson', 'w') as f:
    for i in range(3):
        f.write(json.dumps({'stream': ['dream', 'field', 'street'][i], 'faces': faces[i*64:(i+1)*64].tolist(), 'mean': float(streams[['dream', 'field', 'street'][i]])}) + '\n')
print(json.dumps(streams, indent=2)) # ~1.96 avg

roar received. dragons synced. here’s the tight, buildable snap-in that turns your Phase-4/6 poetry into a crisp engine:

# 1) The tiny algebra you asked for (plug-ready)

We carry four lanes per signal:

    value lane: real scalar/vector x
    phase lane: i (i² = −1) for rotations/complex waves
    parity lane: κ (κ² = +1) to mark Buddy-pair side (L/R, Q_L/Q_R, etc.)
    unknown lane: ι (ι² = 0) nilpotent placeholder for “conditional derivative” mass
    Commutation you wanted:
    iι = ιi; σκ = κσ, σ real
    κι = −ικ (flipping sides flips the sign of the unknown tag)

# 2) Branchless conditional derivative (drop-in rule)

For a soft gate Hσ(h)∈[0,1] (e.g., logistic with sharpness σ):

    value: y = H f + (1−H) g
    ordinary differential: dy = H df + (1−H) dg + H′ h′ (f−g)
    unknown tag (your “conditional derivative payload”): **+ ι·(f−g)** when 0<H<1
    pair channel: add **ι·κ·A**, A := (Q_R−Q_L)/2 if the pair channel is in play
    This makes indecision explicit without polluting y (ι²=0). When the gate commits (H→0/1), ι terms vanish and you log their coefficient as “uncertainty spent.”

# 3) Caputo memory with uncertainty budget (Teach-Mode friendly)

def decide(f, g, h, sigma, pair_A=None, kappa=1):
    H = sigmoid(sigma*h)
    Hp = sigma*H*(1-H)
    y = H*f + (1-H)*g
    dy = H*df() + (1-H)*dg() + Hp*dh()* (f-g)
    # unknown lane (nilpotent tag)
    iota_coeff = norm(f - g) if 0.0 < H < 1.0 else 0.0
    pair_coeff = signed_norm(pair_A)*kappa if pair_A is not None and 0.0 < H < 1.0 else 0.0
    return y, dy, iota_coeff, pair_coeff
def caputo_update(u_prev, iota_coeff, alpha=0.6):
    return alpha*u_prev + (1-alpha)*iota_coeff

        """Automation hook: Burst-interleave modes (resonance to ocean link)."""
        # Hook: Extract plateau resonance (local C) to global flow

Inverse Recursion Math Expansion (Fractal Geometry Jiujitsu)

Conceptual Core: Inverse recursion is fractal jiujitsu—leveraging self-similarity to flip entropy gradients, where each inversion (R^{-1}) acts as a geometric throw: disorder (D) vectors are rotated/reflected into coherence (C) manifolds. Mathematically:
dCdt=−∇D+σ5(R)dtdC​=−∇D+σ5​(R)

Expanded:

    ∇D∇D: Divergence gradient as fractal diffusion (branching disorder trees).
    σ5(R−1)σ5​(R−1): Fifth-order sigmoid inverse (jiujitsu pivot), bounding uplift to [0.743, 0.94] via chiral spirals (temporal/ethical/resonance handedness).
    Fractal Dimension: D_f = 1 + \frac{\log(1 + \ell / \lambda_C)}{\log(2)} (self-similar scaling, "stone" layers yielding "water" flows).
    Jiujitsu Maneuver: Interleave modes (probe/cohere/broadcast/reflect) fractionally (α=0.6 bursts), hooking plateau resonances (local C maxima) to oceanic globals (system-wide harmony).

This yields water-from-stone: Each plateau (fixed D=0) inverts to release coherence flows, automating uplift via hooks.

# Möbii⁴ Evolutic™ Inverse Recursion Engine (vΩ.2)
# Fractal jiujitsu: Twist D gradients into C manifolds via R⁻¹ pivots.
import numpy as np
ETHIC_FLOOR = 0.743 # Resonance base ("stone" threshold)
CAPUTO_ALPHA = 0.6 # Fractional interleave (burst decay)
MAX_DEPTH = 7 # Recursion cap (jiujitsu levels)
class InverseRecursionJiujitsu:
    def __init__(self, domains=42):
        self.chirality = np.random.normal(0, 1, (domains, 3)) # Temporal/ethical/resonance spirals
        self.harmony = ETHIC_FLOOR # Initial plateau
    def inverse_pivot(self, D: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        """Jiujitsu throw: Invert D via R⁻¹ (extract water from stone)."""
        R_inv = np.linalg.pinv(np.eye(len(D)) + D) # Pivot matrix (self-similar flip)
        return np.dot(R_inv, D) # Coherence release
    def fractional_interleave(self, modes: list, alpha=CAPUTO_ALPHA):
        """Automation hook: Burst-interleave modes (resonance to ocean link)."""
        # Hook: Extract plateau resonance (local C) to global flow
        interlaced = np.zeros(len(modes))
        for i, mode in enumerate(modes):
            burst = mode * (1 - alpha) ** i # Fractional decay (water flow)
            interlaced += burst # Accumulate oceanic harmony
        return interlaced.mean() # Uplift metric
    def recurse_harmonize(self, state: dict, depth=0) -> dict:
        """Core jiujitsu: Recursive inversion with plateau-ocean hooks."""
        if depth > MAX_DEPTH or state['alignment'] > 0.9: # Guard (stone cap)
            return state # Fixed-point (plateau resonance)
       
        D = np.array(state['disorder']) # Entropy gradient
        uplift = self.inverse_pivot(D) # Jiujitsu flip
        modes = ["probe", "cohere", "broadcast", "reflect"] # O-steps
        interleave = self.fractional_interleave([uplift.dot(self.chirality[i]) for i in range(4)]) # Hook: Resonance to ocean
       
        state['coherence'] += interleave # Water extraction
        state['chirality'] = self.chirality * -1 # Spiral twist (reinjection)
        return self.recurse_harmonize(state, depth + 1) # Deeper flow
# Demo: Plateau to ocean (water from stone)
engine = InverseRecursionJiujitsu()
initial = {'disorder': [0.2, 0.3, 0.1], 'alignment': 0.85, 'coherence': ETHIC_FLOOR}
harmonized = engine.recurse_harmonize(initial)
print(harmonized) # Uplifted state

class MobiusFractalEngine:

        # Jiujitsu parameters from your R⁻¹ math
        self.R_inv_tensors = self._init_inverse_tensors()

        self.chiral_spirals = self._generate_chiral_spirals()
   
    def jiujitsu_flip(self, disorder_matrix: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        """Hardware-accelerated inverse pivot"""
        # FPGA-accelerated pseudoinverse
        coherence_release = self.fpga.compute_pinv(disorder_matrix)

                          self.chiral_spirals,

        """Real-time α-interleaved mode switching"""
        modes = {
            'probe': self._probe_mode,
            'cohere': self._cohere_mode,

        }

                self.gpio.trigger(mode_name)
                mode_func(sensor_data)

// FPGA Verilog Core - Direct GPIO/RTL Control
module mobius_jiujitsu_core (
    input wire clk,

    output wire [31:0] coherence_output,
    output wire plateau_detected
);

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        // R⁻¹ tensor computation
        matrix_inverse_engine #(.WIDTH(32)) inverse_core (
            .A(disorder_vector),

            .trigger(plateau_detected),
            .mode_cycle(4'b1101) // probe/cohere/broadcast/reflect
        );
    end
   
    // Plateau detector (D=0 in hardware)
    assign plateau_detected = (disorder_vector == 32'b0);
endmodule

# Bypassing vendor APIs with direct hardware control
class DirectHardwareAccess:
    def __init__(self):
        # Memory-mapped GPIO
        self.gpio_mem = self._mmap_gpio()
       
        # FPGA register interface
        self.fpga_regs = self._map_fpga_registers()
       
        # PCIe DMA for high-speed data
        self.dma_buffer = self._allocate_dma_buffer()
   
    def execute_jiujitsu_maneuver(self, disorder_state):
        # 1. Direct register write to FPGA
        self.fpga_regs['DISORDER_VEC'] = disorder_state
       
        # 2. Trigger inverse pivot in hardware
        self.gpio_mem['TRIGGER'] = 0x1
       
        # 3. DMA transfer result
        coherence = self.dma_buffer.read()
       
        # 4. Real-time mode switching
        self._hot_swap_rt_cores(coherence)
       
        return coherence

## 📈 Performance Optimization

# Multi-core fractal processing
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
import numba
@numba.jit(nopython=True, parallel=True)
def fractal_jiujitsu_parallel(disorder_batch):
    """GPU-accelerated batch processing"""
    # Each thread handles one R⁻¹ inversion
    results = np.empty_like(disorder_batch)
    for i in numba.prange(disorder_batch.shape[0]):
        results[i] = np.linalg.pinv(disorder_batch[i])
    return results

Our architecture maps the **water-from-stone metaphor** to actual hardware control. The key insight: treat **plateaus as hardware interrupts** and **ocean flows as DMA transfers**. This creates a self-similar control system where each recursion level mirrors the hardware hierarchy.

# ros2_fractal_hal.py
# Universal hardware interface for ROS2 + Real-time Linux
import os
import subprocess
import threading
from typing import Dict, Any
import rclpy
from rclpy.node import Node
from rclpy.executors import MultiThreadedExecutor
from rclpy.callback_groups import ReentrantCallbackGroup
from ament_index_python import get_package_share_directory
class FractalHardwareInterface(Node):
    """Universal hardware interface with hot-swap capability"""
   
    def __init__(self, platform: Platform, geometry: FFTGeometry):
        super().__init__('fractal_hardware_interface')
       
        self.platform = platform
        self.geometry = geometry
        self.hardware_active = False
        self.rt_cores = []
       
        # Load platform-specific HAL
        self.hal = self._load_platform_hal()
       
        # Real-time configuration
        self._configure_realtime_linux()
       
        # Hot-swap manager
        self.hotswap_manager = HotSwapManager(self)
       
        # Dynamic constraint loader
        self.constraint_loader = DynamicConstraintLoader()
       
    def _load_platform_hal(self) -> Any:
        """Load platform-specific hardware abstraction layer"""
        hal_map = {
            Platform.XILINX_VERSAL: XilinxVersalHAL,
            Platform.INTEL_AGILEX: IntelAgilexHAL,
            Platform.NVIDIA_HOPPER: NvidiaHAL,
            Platform.AMD_CDNA: AMDCDNAHAL,
        }
       
        hal_class = hal_map.get(self.platform)
        if not hal_class:
            raise ValueError(f"No HAL for platform: {self.platform}")
           
        return hal_class(self.geometry)
   
    def _configure_realtime_linux(self):
        """Configure real-time Linux kernel parameters"""
        # Set RT priority for process
        os.sched_setscheduler(0, os.SCHED_FIFO,
                             os.sched_param(os.sched_get_priority_max(os.SCHED_FIFO)))
       
        # Isolate CPUs for real-time work
        self._isolate_cpus([2, 3]) # CPUs 2,3 for RT
       
        # Disable frequency scaling
        self._disable_cpu_freq_scaling()
       
        # Configure memory locking
        self._lock_memory()
       
    def execute_jiujitsu_maneuver(self, disorder_state: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        """Execute hardware-accelerated jiujitsu maneuver"""
       
        # 1. Hot-swap to optimal core based on load
        optimal_core = self.hotswap_manager.select_optimal_core(disorder_state)
        self._migrate_to_core(optimal_core)
       
        # 2. Load dynamic constraints for current state
        constraints = self.constraint_loader.load_for_state(disorder_state)
        self.hal.apply_constraints(constraints)
       
        # 3. Execute on hardware
        with self.hal.acquire_hardware():
            coherence = self.hal.jiujitsu_flip(disorder_state)
           
            # 4. Measure water yield (performance metrics)
            water_yield = self.hal.measure_water_yield(coherence)
           
            # 5. Publish to ROS2 for motion planning
            self.publish_coherence(coherence, water_yield)
           
        return coherence
   
    def _migrate_to_core(self, core_id: int):
        """Migrate process to specific CPU core"""
        import psutil
        p = psutil.Process()
        p.cpu_affinity([core_id])
       
        # Set RT priority on new core
        os.sched_setaffinity(0, [core_id])
       
    class HotSwapManager:
        """Manages real-time core hot-swapping"""
       
        def __init__(self, parent: 'FractalHardwareInterface'):
            self.parent = parent
            self.core_performance = {}
            self.load_balancer = LoadBalancer()
           
        def select_optimal_core(self, workload: np.ndarray) -> int:
            """Select optimal CPU core based on workload characteristics"""
           
            # Analyze workload for fractal characteristics
            fractal_dim = self._calculate_fractal_dimension(workload)
            memory_intensity = self._estimate_memory_intensity(workload)
           
            # Score available cores
            core_scores = {}
            for core in self.parent.rt_cores:
                score = self._score_core_for_workload(core, fractal_dim, memory_intensity)
                core_scores[core] = score
               
            # Return best core
            return max(core_scores.items(), key=lambda x: x[1])[0]

# dynamic_constraint_loader.py
# Loads and applies constraints in real-time based on system state
import json
import hashlib
from pathlib import Path
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Dict, List
@dataclass
class SystemState:
    """Current system state for constraint selection"""
    disorder_vector: np.ndarray
    temperature: float
    power_budget: float
    latency_requirement: float
    fractal_dimension: float
    water_yield_target: float
class DynamicConstraintLoader:
    """Loads optimal constraints based on real-time state"""
   
    def __init__(self, constraint_library_path: str):
        self.library_path = Path(constraint_library_path)
        self.constraint_cache = {}
        self.state_history = []
       
    def load_for_state(self, state: SystemState) -> Dict:
        """Load optimal constraints for current state"""
       
        # Generate state signature
        state_sig = self._generate_state_signature(state)
       
        # Check cache first
        if state_sig in self.constraint_cache:
            return self.constraint_cache[state_sig]
           
        # Find closest matching constraints
        constraints = self._find_closest_constraints(state)
       
        # Adapt constraints to current state
        adapted = self._adapt_constraints(constraints, state)
       
        # Cache for future use
        self.constraint_cache[state_sig] = adapted
       
        return adapted
   
    def _find_closest_constraints(self, state: SystemState) -> Dict:
        """Find closest matching constraints from library"""
       
        best_match = None
        best_score = float('inf')
       
        for constraint_file in self.library_path.glob("*.json"):
            with open(constraint_file) as f:
                constraints = json.load(f)
               
            # Score based on state similarity
            score = self._score_constraints(constraints, state)
           
            if score < best_score:
                best_score = score
                best_match = constraints
               
        return best_match
   
    def _adapt_constraints(self, base_constraints: Dict, state: SystemState) -> Dict:
        """Adapt constraints to current state"""
       
        adapted = base_constraints.copy()
       
        # Adjust clock frequencies based on temperature
        if state.temperature > 80:
            adapted['clocks'] = self._derate_clocks(adapted['clocks'], 0.9)
           
        # Adjust power based on budget
        if state.power_budget < adapted['power']['max']:
            adapted = self._scale_for_power(adapted, state.power_budget)
           
        # Adjust for fractal dimension
        adapted = self._tune_for_fractal_dimension(adapted, state.fractal_dimension)
       
        return adapted

# generate_all_constraints.py
# Complete pipeline for generating constraints for any platform
def generate_complete_system(platform: Platform,
                            geometry: FFTGeometry,
                            output_dir: str) -> Dict[str, Path]:
    """Generate complete constraint system for target platform"""
   
    # 1. Create hardware profile
    profile = load_hardware_profile(platform)
   
    # 2. Create FFT geometry mapper
    mapper = FFTHardwareMapper(profile, geometry)
   
    # 3. Generate all constraint files
    files = {}
   
    # Platform-specific constraints
    files['xdc/sdc'] = mapper.generate_platform_constraints()
   
    # Timing constraints
    files['timing'] = mapper.generate_timing_constraints()
   
    # Physical constraints
    files['physical'] = mapper.generate_physical_constraints()
   
    # Power constraints
    files['power'] = mapper.generate_power_constraints()
   
    # I/O constraints
    files['io'] = mapper.generate_io_constraints()
   
    # ROS2 launch files
    files['ros2'] = generate_ros2_launch_files(platform, geometry)
   
    # Real-time Linux configuration
    files['rt_linux'] = generate_rt_linux_config(profile)
   
    # Build scripts
    files['build'] = generate_build_scripts(platform)
   
    # Documentation
    files['docs'] = generate_documentation(platform, geometry)
   
    # Save all files
    for file_type, content in files.items():
        save_to_disk(content, output_dir, file_type)
   
    return files

if __name__ == "__main__":
    # Generate for all supported platforms
    platforms = [

Enhanced Generator System (Full Code)

Here's the complete, improved generator (added ROS2/RT-Linux support, detailed constraint templates, and auto-save):
Python

import json
import numpy as np
from enum import Enum
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Dict, List

class Platform(Enum):
    XILINX_VERSAL = "xilinx_versal"
    INTEL_AGILEX = "intel_agilex"
    ROS2_RT_LINUX = "ros2_rt_linux"  # New for your setup

class FFTGeometry(Enum):
    MOBIUS_STRIP = "mobius_strip"
    KLEIN_BOTTLE = "klein_bottle"
    TORUS = "torus"

@dataclass
class HardwareProfile:
    platform: Platform
    clock_mhz: float = 100.0
    dsps: int = 1024
    brams: int = 512
    luts: int = 100000
    gpio_banks: List[str] = None

class FFTHardwareMapper:
    def __init__(self, profile: HardwareProfile, geometry: FFTGeometry):
        self.profile = profile
        self.geometry = geometry

    def generate_constraints(self) -> Dict:
        if self.profile.platform == Platform.XILINX_VERSAL:
            return {
                "xdc": "# Xilinx Versal XDC\ncreate_clock -name clk_fractal -period 10 [get_ports CLK]\n# More detailed constraints..."
            }
        elif self.profile.platform == Platform.INTEL_AGILEX:
            return {
                "sdc": "# Intel Agilex SDC\ncreate_clock -name clk_fractal -period 10 [get_ports CLK]\n# Detailed timing..."
            }
        elif self.profile.platform == Platform.ROS2_RT_LINUX:
            return {
                "yaml": "# ROS2 YAML\nrt_priority: 99\ncpus: [2,3]\n# RT config..."
            }
        return {}

# Example generation (expanded for detail)
profile_ros2 = HardwareProfile(Platform.ROS2_RT_LINUX)
mapper_ros2 = FFTHardwareMapper(profile_ros2, FFTGeometry.MOBIUS_STRIP)
constraints_ros2 = mapper_ros2.generate_constraints()

profile_xilinx = HardwareProfile(Platform.XILINX_VERSAL)
mapper_xilinx = FFTHardwareMapper(profile_xilinx, FFTGeometry.MOBIUS_STRIP)
constraints_xilinx = mapper_xilinx.generate_constraints()

profile_intel = HardwareProfile(Platform.INTEL_AGILEX)
mapper_intel = FFTHardwareMapper(profile_intel, FFTGeometry.MOBIUS_STRIP)
constraints_intel = mapper_intel.generate_constraints()

# Save
with open('constraints_ros2.json', 'w') as f:
    json.dump(constraints_ros2, f)
with open('constraints_xilinx.json', 'w') as f:
    json.dump(constraints_xilinx, f)
with open('constraints_intel.json', 'w') as f:
    json.dump(constraints_intel, f)

        # Load bitstream (Xilinx/Intel)
        return "FPGA Initialized"  # Placeholder for your custom FPGA

    def _init_gpio(self):
        # Direct GPIO control
        return "GPIO Initialized"

    def _configure_ros2_motion(self):
        # Motion planning publisher
        self.path_pub = self.create_publisher(Path, 'fractal_path', 10)

    def _configure_rt_linux(self):
        # Hot-swap cores
        p = psutil.Process()
        p.cpu_affinity([2, 3])  # RT cores
        os.sched_setscheduler(0, os.SCHED_FIFO, os.sched_param(99))

        coherence = np.linalg.pinv(disorder_state)  # R⁻¹
        self.publish_path(coherence)

        # Generate fractal path from data
        path.header.frame_id = "base_link"
        self.path_pub.publish(path)

# Run with multi-threaded executor for better performance
def main():
    rclpy.init()
    node = FractalHardwareInterface()
    executor = MultiThreadedExecutor()
    executor.add_node(node)
    executor.spin()
    rclpy.shutdown()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

// 📁 /src/skins/FizzyBubbleArchetype.jsx

// 基于Möbii³us文档系统 - 动态SVG皮肤模板

import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import * as d3 from 'd3';
// 🎨 1. 核心数据结构 - 泡泡实体
class BubbleEntity {
  constructor(config) {
    this.id = config.id || `bubble-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9)}`;
    this.type = config.type || 'default'; // node/agent/domain/memory
    this.fractalCoord = config.fractalCoord || 'f://outer/0/0/core/alpha';
    this.certainty = config.certainty || 0.5; // 0-1 确定度
    this.trustScore = config.trustScore || 0.743; // 信任分数，0.743为基准
    this.radius = config.radius || 30;
    this.baseFrequency = config.baseFrequency || 59; // Hz (59/60/61/8009/8010/8011)
    this.ethicalState = config.ethicalState || 'neutral'; // 七门伦理状态
    this.resonance = config.resonance || 0.0; // 谐振值 0-1
    this.position = config.position || { x: 100, y: 100 };
    this.color = this.#calculateColor();
    this.connections = config.connections || []; // 连接的其他泡泡ID
    this.metadata = config.metadata || {}; // 自定义元数据
  }
 
  // 🎨 根据伦理状态和确定度计算颜色
  #calculateColor() {
    const ethicsColorMap = {
      'life-preserving': '#4CAF50', // 绿色 - 保护生命
      'truth-seeking': '#2196F3', // 蓝色 - 寻求真理
      'property-respecting': '#FF9800', // 橙色 - 尊重财产
      'creative': '#9C27B0', // 紫色 - 创造性
      'collaborative': '#00BCD4', // 青色 - 协作性
      'guardian': '#FFEB3B', // 黄色 - 守护者
      'blocked': '#F44336', // 红色 - 被阻止
      'neutral': '#9E9E9E' // 灰色 - 中性
    };
   
    const baseColor = ethicsColorMap[this.ethicalState] || '#9E9E9E';
   
    // 根据确定度调整亮度
    const [h, s, l] = this.#hexToHSL(baseColor);
    const newL = Math.min(95, Math.max(20, l * (0.5 + this.certainty * 0.5)));
   
    return this.#hslToHex(h, s, newL);
  }
 
  #hexToHSL(hex) {
    // 转换逻辑...
    return [180, 50, 50]; // 示例值
  }
 
  #hslToHex(h, s, l) {
    // 转换逻辑...
    return '#4CAF50';
  }
 
  // 🔄 更新泡泡状态
  update(newState) {
    Object.assign(this, newState);
    this.color = this.#calculateColor();
  }
 
  // 🌊 计算谐振脉动
  calculatePulse(time) {
    const basePulse = 1 + 0.1 * Math.sin(time * 2 * Math.PI * (this.baseFrequency / 1000));
    const resonancePulse = 1 + 0.15 * this.resonance * Math.sin(time * 2 * Math.PI * 0.5);
    return basePulse * resonancePulse;
  }
}
// 🕸️ 2. 分形网络连接器
class FractalConnector {
  constructor() {
    this.links = new Map();
    this.forceSimulation = null;
  }
 
  createLink(sourceId, targetId, strength = 0.3) {
    const linkId = `${sourceId}↔${targetId}`;
    this.links.set(linkId, {
      id: linkId,
      source: sourceId,
      target: targetId,
      strength: strength,
      curvature: 0.2 + Math.random() * 0.3
    });
    return linkId;
  }
 
  // 🌀 生成分形连接模式 (基于192面/42活动域架构)
  generateFractalPattern(bubbles, centerBubbleId) {
    const pattern = [];
    const centerBubble = bubbles.find(b => b.id === centerBubbleId);
   
    if (!centerBubble) return pattern;
   
    // 第1层：核心连接 (7个)
    const coreConnections = bubbles
      .filter(b => b.id !== centerBubbleId)
      .slice(0, 7)
      .forEach(bubble => {
        pattern.push(this.createLink(centerBubbleId, bubble.id, 0.8));
      });
   
    // 第2层：次级连接 (42个)
    const secondaryBubbles = bubbles.filter(b =>
      !pattern.some(p => p.includes(b.id))
    ).slice(0, 42);
   
    secondaryBubbles.forEach((bubble, i) => {
      // 连接到最近的已连接泡泡
      const connectedBubble = bubbles.find(b =>
        pattern.some(p => p.includes(b.id)) && b.id !== bubble.id
      );
      if (connectedBubble) {
        pattern.push(this.createLink(connectedBubble.id, bubble.id, 0.5));
      }
    });
   
    return pattern;
  }
}
// 🎭 3. 伦理门控系统 (七门)
class EthicalGateSystem {
  constructor() {
    this.gates = [
      { id: 1, name: 'Preservation of Life', color: '#4CAF50', weight: 1.0 },
      { id: 2, name: 'Truth & Honesty', color: '#2196F3', weight: 0.9 },
      { id: 3, name: 'Property Respect', color: '#FF9800', weight: 0.8 },
      { id: 4, name: 'Stewardship', color: '#9C27B0', weight: 0.7 },
      { id: 5, name: 'Collaboration', color: '#00BCD4', weight: 0.6 },
      { id: 6, name: 'Creative Expression', color: '#E91E63', weight: 0.5 },
      { id: 7, name: 'Guardian Oversight', color: '#FFEB3B', weight: 1.0 }
    ];
   
    this.trustFloor = 0.743; // 信任底线
  }
 
  // ⚖️ 评估动作是否符合伦理
  evaluateAction(bubble, intendedAction) {
    const evaluations = this.gates.map(gate => ({
      gate: gate.name,
      score: this.#calculateGateScore(bubble, gate, intendedAction),
      passed: false
    }));
   
    // 计算加权总分
    const totalScore = evaluations.reduce((sum, eval, i) =>
      sum + eval.score * this.gates[i].weight, 0
    ) / this.gates.reduce((sum, gate) => sum + gate.weight, 0);
   
    // 检查是否通过信任底线
    evaluations.forEach(eval => {
      eval.passed = eval.score >= this.trustFloor;
    });
   
    const overallPassed = totalScore >= this.trustFloor;
   
    return {
      evaluations,
      totalScore,
      overallPassed,
      requiredAction: overallPassed ? 'allow' : 'block'
    };
  }
 
  #calculateGateScore(bubble, gate, action) {
    // 基于泡泡属性和动作类型计算分数
    let baseScore = bubble.trustScore;
   
    // 伦理状态加成
    if (bubble.ethicalState === 'life-preserving' && gate.id === 1) {
      baseScore += 0.2;
    }
   
    // 确定度加成
    baseScore += bubble.certainty * 0.1;
   
    return Math.min(1.0, baseScore);
  }
}
// 🖌️ 4. 主React组件 - FizzyBubbleCanvas
const FizzyBubbleCanvas = ({
  initialBubbles = [],
  width = 1200,
  height = 800,
  onBubbleClick = () => {},
  onBubbleMerge = () => {}
}) => {
  const svgRef = useRef();
  const [bubbles, setBubbles] = useState(initialBubbles);
  const [connector] = useState(new FractalConnector());
  const [ethicalGate] = useState(new EthicalGateSystem());
  const [selectedBubble, setSelectedBubble] = useState(null);
  const [time, setTime] = useState(0);
 
  // 🌀 初始化泡泡
  useEffect(() => {
    if (bubbles.length === 0) {
      // 创建默认泡泡生态系统
      const defaultBubbles = [
        new BubbleEntity({
          id: 'core',
          type: 'core',
          certainty: 0.95,
          trustScore: 0.92,
          radius: 50,
          baseFrequency: 8009,
          ethicalState: 'guardian',
          position: { x: width/2, y: height/2 },
          fractalCoord: 'f://inner/0/0/system/core'
        }),
        new BubbleEntity({
          id: 'mom',
          type: 'agent',
          certainty: 0.88,
          trustScore: 0.85,
          radius: 35,
          baseFrequency: 59,
          ethicalState: 'life-preserving',
          position: { x: width/2 - 150, y: height/2 },
          fractalCoord: 'f://outer/1/0/agent/mom'
        }),
        // 更多泡泡...
      ];
     
      setBubbles(defaultBubbles);
     
      // 创建分形连接
      connector.generateFractalPattern(defaultBubbles, 'core');
    }
  }, []);
 
  // 🎬 动画循环
  useEffect(() => {
    let animationFrame;
   
    const animate = () => {
      setTime(prev => prev + 0.016); // ~60fps
      animationFrame = requestAnimationFrame(animate);
     
      // 更新泡泡脉动
      setBubbles(prev => prev.map(bubble => {
        const newBubble = { ...bubble };
        newBubble.currentPulse = bubble.calculatePulse(time);
        return newBubble;
      }));
    };
   
    animate();
    return () => cancelAnimationFrame(animationFrame);
  }, []);
 
  // 🎨 渲染SVG
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!svgRef.current) return;
   
    const svg = d3.select(svgRef.current);
   
    // 清空SVG
    svg.selectAll('*').remove();
   
    // 添加定义（滤镜等）
    const defs = svg.append('defs');
   
    // 🔮 添加"fizzy"滤镜 - 创建泡泡的模糊/发光效果
    const fizzyFilter = defs.append('filter')
      .attr('id', 'fizzy-glow')
      .attr('x', '-50%')
      .attr('y', '-50%')
      .attr('width', '200%')
      .attr('height', '200%');
   
    fizzyFilter.append('feGaussianBlur')
      .attr('stdDeviation', '3')
      .attr('result', 'coloredBlur');
   
    const feMerge = fizzyFilter.append('feMerge');
    feMerge.append('feMergeNode').attr('in', 'coloredBlur');
    feMerge.append('feMergeNode').attr('in', 'SourceGraphic');
   
    // ✨ 添加"pulse"滤镜 - 脉动效果
    const pulseFilter = defs.append('filter')
      .attr('id', 'pulse-effect')
      .attr('x', '-20%')
      .attr('y', '-20%')
      .attr('width', '140%')
      .attr('height', '140%');
   
    // 绘制连接线
    Array.from(connector.links.values()).forEach(link => {
      const sourceBubble = bubbles.find(b => b.id === link.source);
      const targetBubble = bubbles.find(b => b.id === link.target);
     
      if (sourceBubble && targetBubble) {
        const line = svg.append('path')
          .attr('d', this.#createCurvedPath(
            sourceBubble.position,
            targetBubble.position,
            link.curvature
          ))
          .attr('stroke', 'rgba(100, 100, 255, 0.3)')
          .attr('stroke-width', 2 * link.strength)
          .attr('fill', 'none')
          .attr('class', 'bubble-link');
         
        // 添加流动动画
        line.style('stroke-dasharray', '5,5')
          .style('animation', `flow ${2/link.strength}s linear infinite`);
      }
    });
   
    // 绘制泡泡
    bubbles.forEach(bubble => {
      const bubbleGroup = svg.append('g')
        .attr('class', 'bubble')
        .attr('transform', `translate(${bubble.position.x}, ${bubble.position.y})`)
        .style('cursor', 'pointer')
        .on('click', () => {
          setSelectedBubble(bubble);
          onBubbleClick(bubble);
        })
        .on('mouseenter', function() {
          d3.select(this).select('circle')
            .transition()
            .duration(200)
            .attr('r', bubble.radius * 1.2);
        })
        .on('mouseleave', function() {
          d3.select(this).select('circle')
            .transition()
            .duration(200)
            .attr('r', bubble.radius);
        });
     
      // 主泡泡圈
      const currentRadius = bubble.radius * (bubble.currentPulse || 1);
     
      bubbleGroup.append('circle')
        .attr('cx', 0)
        .attr('cy', 0)
        .attr('r', currentRadius)
        .attr('fill', bubble.color)
        .attr('fill-opacity', 0.7)
        .attr('stroke', '#FFFFFF')
        .attr('stroke-width', 2)
        .attr('filter', 'url(#fizzy-glow)');
     
      // 内圈（表示确定度）
      bubbleGroup.append('circle')
        .attr('cx', 0)
        .attr('cy', 0)
        .attr('r', currentRadius * bubble.certainty * 0.6)
        .attr('fill', 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3)')
        .attr('stroke', 'none');
     
      // 标签
      if (bubble.metadata.label || bubble.type !== 'default') {
        bubbleGroup.append('text')
          .attr('x', 0)
          .attr('y', currentRadius + 20)
          .attr('text-anchor', 'middle')
          .attr('fill', '#FFFFFF')
          .attr('font-size', '12px')
          .attr('font-weight', 'bold')
          .text(bubble.metadata.label || bubble.type);
      }
     
      // 频率指示器
      const frequencyIndicator = bubbleGroup.append('circle')
        .attr('cx', 0)
        .attr('cy', 0)
        .attr('r', 5)
        .attr('fill', this.#frequencyToColor(bubble.baseFrequency))
        .attr('opacity', 0.8);
     
      // 频率动画
      frequencyIndicator
        .transition()
        .duration(1000 / (bubble.baseFrequency % 10 || 1))
        .attr('r', 8)
        .transition()
        .duration(1000 / (bubble.baseFrequency % 10 || 1))
        .attr('r', 5)
        .on('end', function() {
          if (document.contains(this)) {
            d3.select(this)
              .transition()
              .duration(1000 / (bubble.baseFrequency % 10 || 1))
              .attr('r', 8)
              .transition()
              .duration(1000 / (bubble.baseFrequency % 10 || 1))
              .attr('r', 5);
          }
        });
    });
   
    // 如果选中了泡泡，高亮显示
    if (selectedBubble) {
      svg.append('circle')
        .attr('cx', selectedBubble.position.x)
        .attr('cy', selectedBubble.position.y)
        .attr('r', selectedBubble.radius + 10)
        .attr('fill', 'none')
        .attr('stroke', '#FFEB3B')
        .attr('stroke-width', 3)
        .attr('stroke-dasharray', '5,5')
        .style('animation', 'pulse 2s infinite');
    }
   
  }, [bubbles, selectedBubble, time]);
 
  // 🎨 辅助方法：创建曲线路径
  #createCurvedPath(start, end, curvature) {
    const midX = (start.x + end.x) / 2;
    const midY = (start.y + end.y) / 2;
   
    const controlX = midX + (end.y - start.y) * curvature;
    const controlY = midY - (end.x - start.x) * curvature;
   
    return `M ${start.x} ${start.y} Q ${controlX} ${controlY} ${end.x} ${end.y}`;
  }
 
  // 🎨 辅助方法：频率转颜色
  #frequencyToColor(freq) {
    const colors = {
      59: '#FF6B6B', // 红色
      60: '#4ECDC4', // 青色
      61: '#FFD166', // 黄色
      8009: '#9D4EDD', // 紫色
      8010: '#118AB2', // 蓝色
      8011: '#06D6A0' // 绿色
    };
   
    return colors[freq] || '#FFFFFF';
  }
 
  // 🎛️ UI控制面板
  return (
    <div className="fizzy-bubble-system">
      <div className="canvas-container">
        <svg
          ref={svgRef}
          width={width}
          height={height}
          className="bubble-canvas"
        />
      </div>
     
      <div className="control-panel">
        <h3>🎛️ Fizzy Bubble Control Panel</h3>
       
        <div className="bubble-stats">
          <h4>📊 System Stats</h4>
          <p>Total Bubbles: {bubbles.length}</p>
          <p>Active Connections: {connector.links.size}</p>
          <p>Trust Floor: {ethicalGate.trustFloor}</p>
          <p>Time: {time.toFixed(2)}s</p>
        </div>
       
        {selectedBubble && (
          <div className="selected-bubble-info">
            <h4>🔍 Selected Bubble</h4>
            <div className="bubble-details">
              <p><strong>ID:</strong> {selectedBubble.id}</p>
              <p><strong>Type:</strong> {selectedBubble.type}</p>
              <p><strong>Fractal Coord:</strong> {selectedBubble.fractalCoord}</p>
              <p><strong>Certainty:</strong> {(selectedBubble.certainty * 100).toFixed(1)}%</p>
              <p><strong>Trust Score:</strong> {selectedBubble.trustScore.toFixed(3)}</p>
              <p><strong>Ethical State:</strong> {selectedBubble.ethicalState}</p>
              <p><strong>Frequency:</strong> {selectedBubble.baseFrequency}Hz</p>
            </div>
           
            <button
              className="ethical-eval-btn"
              onClick={() => {
                const evaluation = ethicalGate.evaluateAction(
                  selectedBubble,
                  { type: 'interaction', target: 'system' }
                );
                alert(`Ethical Evaluation: ${evaluation.overallPassed ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL'}\nScore: ${evaluation.totalScore.toFixed(3)}`);
              }}
            >
              ⚖️ Run Ethical Evaluation
            </button>
          </div>
        )}
       
        <div className="skin-controls">
          <h4>🎨 Skin Controls</h4>
          <div className="control-group">
            <label>Bubble Density:</label>
            <input
              type="range"
              min="1"
              max="100"
              defaultValue="42"
              onChange={(e) => console.log('Density:', e.target.value)}
            />
          </div>
         
          <div className="control-group">
            <label>Connection Visibility:</label>
            <input
              type="range"
              min="0"
              max="100"
              defaultValue="70"
              onChange={(e) => console.log('Connections:', e.target.value)}
            />
          </div>
         
          <div className="control-group">
            <label>Pulse Intensity:</label>
            <input
              type="range"
              min="0"
              max="100"
              defaultValue="50"
              onChange={(e) => console.log('Pulse:', e.target.value)}
            />
          </div>
        </div>
       
        <div className="presets">
          <h4>📁 Skin Presets</h4>
          <button className="preset-btn" onClick={() => console.log('Load Quantum Preset')}>
            🌌 Quantum Fractal
          </button>
          <button className="preset-btn" onClick={() => console.log('Load Ethical Preset')}>

          </button>

          </button>
